name: Hana Royce
source:
Arthur's girlfriend who died in an assassination hit by The Syndicate. Her death is the sole reason that drives Arthur to become an assassin and bring about revenge towards The Syndicate.

After her death, Arthur begins to have dreams and nightmares of her.
